bio.text: Kweisi Mfume represents Maryland's 7th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is serving in the 119th Congress.
Born and raised in Baltimore, he graduated magna cum laude from Morgan State University and later earned a master's degree in liberal arts from Johns Hopkins University.
He was elected to the Baltimore City Council at age 31, and later served in the U.S. House until February 1996, when he left to become president and CEO of the NAACP, a post he held for nine years.
